fields.name: title
fields.title: Rune name
fields.description: Build-defining power card name (Doomblaster / Slideshow / Super Dash / El Granados). Source player_stats.gd SPECIAL_CARDS / combat/bonus_manager.gd.

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Rune id
fields.description: BonusManager stack key (e.g. "doomblaster", "slideshow", "superDash"). El Granados has no combat-side stack (it spends Damage + Magnetic stat points).

fields.name: family
fields.title: Family
fields.description: Which playstyle axis the rune empowers. Source bonus_manager.gd / player_stats.gd SPECIAL_CARDS.

fields.name: stackable
fields.title: Stackable
fields.description: Whether the rune can be picked more than once to deepen its effect (all four currently stack).

fields.name: maxStacks
fields.title: Max stacks
fields.description: Stack cap. Source player_stats.gd SPECIAL_CARDS: Doomblaster 5, El Granados 5, Slideshow 3, Super Dash 3.

fields.name: dropRate
fields.title: Drop rate
fields.description: Per-enemy-kill chance a rune pickup drops (~0.5%, an order rarer than the 5% heart). Source progression/rune_manager.gd doc.

fields.name: damageProfile
fields.title: Damage profile
fields.description: The rune's headline damage term and a clarifying note. Source combat/bonus_manager.gd computed-effect getters.

fields.name: mult
fields.title: Per-stack damage term
fields.description: Per-stack damage contribution (e.g. Doomblaster +2.0/stack, Slideshow/Super Dash +0.10/stack).

fields.name: note
fields.title: Note
fields.description: Free-text clarification (e.g. "slower fire rate trade-off", "scales with slide speed", "only while dashing").

fields.name: modifies
fields.title: Modifies weapon
fields.description: The weapon this rune's effect attaches to (the gun/kick the multiplier folds into).
